in_sanskrit.name: Kallappa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva's servant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kallappa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who serves Lord Shiva, the God of destruction. In Hindu mythology, Kallappa is a divine being and servant of Lord Shiva. He is often depicted as a powerful warrior or elephant-headed god, symbolizing strength and devotion.
